exploit_name: Price cumulative last is used inverted in Uniswap oracle
description: The function inverts the direction logic when reading cumulative prices. price0CumulativeLast represents price of token1 in token0 terms, but code reads price1CumulativeLast when direction == 0 (and vice versa).
root_cause: The function inverts the direction logic when reading cumulative prices. price0CumulativeLast represents price of token1 in token0 terms, but code reads price1CumulativeLast when direction == 0 (and vice versa).
fix_description: Invert the direction comparison: read price0CumulativeLast when direction == 0.
notes: The computed TWAP represents the reciprocal of the intended price ratio, causing validation to fail for legitimate prices or pass for manipulated ones.
